build_system: Vite (frontend) — build command: npm run build; dev: npm run dev. Backend: NestJS with npm run start:dev. Vite proxy in vite.config.js forwards /api to backend.
test_framework: None currently configured on the frontend. Backend has Jest (spec files exist).
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` in the frontend directory. Build must complete with no errors. Then run dev server with `npm run dev` and visually confirm each new page renders at its route.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Frontend dir: c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend. Backend dir: c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\backend-projet\library-management. All frontend edits go in the frontend/src folder. Never edit backend source for this task.
contribution_requirements: Use existing api.js functions only — never fetch directly or use localStorage for API data. Follow workspace.css + App.css class naming. Never overwrite App.css — only append at end.
key_patterns:
Pages wrap content in . States: const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); const [error, setError] = useState(''); const [items, setItems] = useState([]). API calls in useEffect or event handlers, wrapped in try/catch with finally { setLoading(false) }. Error shown with

. Success notice with

. Cards use workspace-cards > workspace-card > workspace-card-top / workspace-badge / workspace-card-actions pattern. Filters use workspace-filters grid. Empty state uses workspace-empty.
directory_structure: frontend/src/pages/ — page components (Home, Login, Register, Dashboard, Archives, Settings, AiGenerator). frontend/src/components/ — DashboardLayout, ContentWorkspace, navbar, ProtectedRoute. frontend/src/context/ — AuthContext (user, login, logout, useAuth). frontend/src/services/ — api.js (all API calls), contentStore.js (localStorage legacy). frontend/src/App.jsx — BrowserRouter + Routes. frontend/src/App.css — global styles. frontend/src/workspace.css — reusable workspace UI classes.
